verdict.rationale: The evidence shows admins can directly set and adjust card spend limits, including through the MCP server. Nothing documents a self-service screen for requesting a transaction limit increase, such as a request or approval workflow or asking Jeeves to raise a limit. Directly editing card spend limits is a related but different control, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can request a transaction limit increase directly from a self-service screen
